articles.title: Thai Teen Guitar Prodigy Nene Royal Shreds Her Way to America's Got Talent Victory
articles.summary: Nene Royal, a 16-year-old from Thailand, won America's Got Talent with her electric guitar. Her audition cover of "Zombie" got 21 million views. Now she wants to make a rock album.

articles.title: Ohio Teen Owen Gee Commits to Texas A&M Swimming for 2028
articles.summary: Owen Gee, a high school swimmer from Morrow, Ohio, has verbally committed to Texas A&M. He's a "Best of the Rest" recruit for the class of 2028 and excels in butterfly.

articles.title: Great Britain Exits Billie Jean King Cup After Quarter-Final Loss to Czech Republic
articles.summary: Britain lost to the Czech Republic in the Billie Jean King Cup quarter-finals. Sonay Kartal fought for three hours in her return from injury, but Katie Boulter also fell. Captain Anne Keothavong said she "cannot fault" the team.
